name: 해방된 할파스
prompt:
Draw six detailed isometric RPG game sprites of EXACTLY 해방된 할파스 from the attached original character portrait. Preserve the specific reference body, face, helmet/horns, armor, wings, cloak, colors and actual weapon design. Do not invent new anatomy or add a long energy trail.

This is a deliberately SPARSE technical atlas, not a full-page illustration. EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS,1024x1536 pixels. Six cells of512x512 each. Each complete character silhouette must be AT MOST320x320 pixels, including every wing/horn/weapon/flame tip. This size cap is mandatory. Position each figure inside the central320x320 portion of its cell. Leave at least96pixels of completely empty transparent space on every cell edge. More than70percent of the whole image should remain empty transparent background. Do NOT enlarge characters to fill the empty canvas. The empty gutters are essential. No pair of character bounding rectangles may overlap.

ALL6 full figures face screenRIGHT/EAST, same camera, same body proportions and uniform scale. Temporal order left-to-right then down. Animate slow airborne locomotion with six genuinely distinct phases of propulsion/recovery. Preserve exact purple crystalline wing anatomy. Opposite arms/legs and cape move coherently with thrust/compression/recovery. No feather wings or generic dragon substitute. One coherent character per cell; no detached ornaments, spare weapons, copies or extra figures. Entire anatomy and equipment visible, no cropping. Crisp, hard-edged game sprite cutouts with detailed material shading INSIDE each body. All black armor/skin materials fully opaque. Colored energy must remain contained in the original wing/blade shapes. NO bloom, diffuse aura, surrounding halo, glow circles, colored fog, environmental light gradient, floor, shadow, background panels, text, numbers or grid lines. Outside the exact character silhouette: alpha0, completely transparent. Edge antialiasing only one or two pixels. Use local shading for detailed armor rather than surrounding glow. Keep strong separated poses and the reference identity.
